algorithm: sha256(canonical_json(material)) where material = {fold_id, sorted source_domains, m3b_package_identity, siw_package_identity, siw_split_identity, sorted row_material tuples, schema_version}; row_material tuples are (dataset, project_split, source_video_id, frame_index, crop_sha256, label_live_spoof, status) -- content/identity derived fields ONLY
excluded_from_identity: crop_relative_path string itself (crop_sha256 stands in for it)
